name: tooark-gadget-worklog
description: Worklog por usuário nos últimos N dias

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx @forge/cli@12.21.0 deploy && npx @forge/cli@12.21.0 install --upgrade
scripts.deploy-hml: npm run build && npx @forge/cli@12.21.0 deploy -e staging && npx @forge/cli@12.21.0 install -e staging --upgrade
scripts.deploy-prd: npm run build && npx @forge/cli@12.21.0 deploy -e production && npx @forge/cli@12.21.0 install -e production --upgrade
scripts.deploy-test: npm run build && npm test && npx @forge/cli@12.21.0 deploy && npx @forge/cli@12.21.0 install --upgrade
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run build && npm run lint:forge
